summary: Separate the embedded qndr entry from qndġ.
rationale: A second root heading Qndr with its own etymology is stranded in qndġ.I notes. The following stem mqandarle/mqandar and sense to deceive, coax have final r, whereas qndġ is mqandaġle/mqandəġ, wickeln (Kind). This is an entry boundary lost during structuring, not a second stem of qndġ. The allowed lookup finds no standalone qndr entry.

summary: Is mqadarle missing n, or does it preserve an actual variant?
rationale: The stated base forms are mqandarle/mqandar and the embedded root heading is Qndr, but the sole example has mqadarle without n. There is no supplied corpus verse or independent attestation for this example, so an automatic restoration of n would be conjectural.
